questions.question:
Statements:
1. All pens are books.
2. All books are tables.
3. Some tables are chairs.

Conclusions:
I. All pens are tables.
II. All pens are chairs.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: Conclusion I ("All pens are tables.") follows: it is true in every diagram that fits the three statements. Conclusion II ("All pens are chairs.") does not follow: the statements leave it open, because a consistent diagram makes it false. Answer: Only conclusion I follows.
